text: The subject is Imran Shafiq, who holds account PK**HABB****4503 opened on 14 December 2023. The subject declared an occupation of Student with a monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month. Between 1 June 2026 and 10 June 2026, the account recorded 20 credits totalling PKR 1,058,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 989,000. The credits consisted of 20 interbank (IBFT) transfers received from 14 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 10 June 2026, where Tazama typology MULE-01 scored 360 against an alert threshold of 300. The receipt of funds from 14 distinct senders is indicative of money mule activity. Debits equal to 93% of credits, with a median of 4.2 hours between the latest credit and each debit, are consistent with suspected money mule activity. Credits in the activity window were 52.9 times the declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month for a Student, which is indicative of money mule activity. The pattern of 14 distinct senders and credits 52.9 times the declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month for a Student is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 549,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. PKR 440,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 June 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review by L2 analyst on 11 June 2026.
